description: Maps short-story (sub-story) message IDs to the voice line spoken with each displayed message.

Id.simple: Message/text ID that keys the voice mapping.
Id.technical: FName primary key. Show-message commands match this value against the displayed message ID; script preload walks all rows and matches it against the script message IDs in order. Export spells it ID.

Id_Voice.simple: VoiceDataTable row to play for that message.
Id_Voice.technical: FName joined to VoiceDataTable. The command parser resolves it to a Voice row and queues that row's CueSheetName/CueName with the message delay and voice slot; script preload resolves it to add the voice cue sheet to the load set. A missing Voice row leaves no queued voice or cue sheet.

notes: Loaded into DTM.ShortStoryVoiceDataTables (+0x780) from the DataTable primary asset ShortStoryVoiceDataTable.

The command parser selects this table when the script name contains STDM_SS_; DLC scripts and ordinary story demos use the other two tables instead. No direct consumer of the DTM array outside FGameScriptCommand_ShowMessageBase::ParseVoice was found in the available source.
GameScriptPlayer does not preload from this table: sub-story scripts hard-code the cue sheet name Part instead.
The export has 580 available rows; retail completeness and Blueprint-only references are not asserted. Sources are reconstructed retail C++.

usages.detail: Collects short-story voice rows for message parsing.
Sub-story preload uses the hard-coded Part cue sheet rather than this table.
